Web, mobile, and the partner were sharing one endpoint with no boundary marking where one consumer's concerns ended and another's began
The database itself is fundamentally unreliable and needs to be replaced before anything else is touched
This specific failure pattern can only happen if the web team personally wrote careless, sloppy code that week
